_comment: Maps each lambda directory to its AWS function names and deploy artifact. Read by .github/workflows/ci.yml and drift-check.yml so the mapping lives in exactly one place. Every lambda now has a QA counterpart, so every change gets a QA rehearsal before the production approval. APNProd (in the apn-lambda-go repo) is deliberately the one exception: it picks the sandbox or production APNs endpoint by bundle ID, so a single function serves both environments correctly.
